title: Example Story (3 scenes)
description: Template showing every field the engine reads. Copy this folder, rename it, swap in your own scenes and reference sheets.

scenes._story_beat: Optional note for yourself - the engine ignores _-prefixed fields.
scenes.veo3_prompt: [SHOT] Wide establishing shot, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. [LOOK] Photorealistic live-action film, natural skin texture, soft cinematic color grade. Alex, 30, short dark hair, navy jacket (match reference image exactly), walks through a quiet morning street. Sam, 28, auburn hair, green coat (match reference image exactly), waits on a bench reading. [AUDIO] Ambient city morning, soft piano bed. Narrator (V.O.): "Every story starts somewhere ordinary."

[CONTINUE from last frame] [SHOT] Medium close-up, handheld, gentle push-in. [LOOK] Photorealistic live-action, consistent with previous frame. Alex slows, glances toward the bench, hesitates, then sits down at the far end. Sam looks up from the book. Neither speaks. [AUDIO] Ambient street, piano continues, a single held string.

[CONTINUE from last frame] [SHOT] Slow pull-back wide, warm practical light. [LOOK] Photorealistic live-action, consistent with previous frame. The two of them now talking easily, both laughing, the book closed on Sam's lap. Camera pulls back until they are two small warm figures in a wide quiet street. [AUDIO] Piano resolves to a final warm chord. Narrator (V.O., gentle): "And sometimes that is enough."
